items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: And Mr. Commander, he can tell you about me, Mr. Adam, Mr. Joseph. Every year I get that job.

ctx.x: That's the first time I've ever seen anything like that. Yeah. First time I've ever seen anything like that.

Well, I mean, last time we finished, she said, we couldn't play out in the yard. But this year, she said, we can give you all that yard. We didn't play upstairs. They got a beautiful dance hall upstairs. She said, Mr. Maher, they called him this morning. And Mr. Commander, he can tell you about me, Mr. Adam, Mr. Joseph. Every year I get that job. Sign a contract. Every year. Nobody else. But I used seven pieces with them. He's very nice. And, man, he got something there. I've never seen nothing like that in my…
